note: Build- and test-time pins of PushMPC's own mpv for Windows on Arm (.github/workflows/mpv-native-arm64.yml). The mpv / FFmpeg / libplacebo / Vulkan-Headers sources are mpvnative/pins.json's; the toolchain and libraries are MSYS2 CLANGARM64 packages (pacman verifies their signatures). Mesa is the CI's Vulkan driver only (lavapipe, a software rasteriser: the portable GPU engine's tests); it is never shipped.

mesa.what: Mesa 26.3.1 for MSYS2 CLANGARM64 (lavapipe: bin/vulkan_lvp.dll, share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.aarch64.json; MIT)
